notes: Answer gives the fourteen mandatory data items (i-xiv) and seven optional items (a-g) from Resolution 5 Part 4 §4.3(1)A and B, plus the operation-reason-specific extra content conditions in §4.2 (NCBO beneficiary and Clients Securities Account condition, same-Share transfers and the System Operator carve-out, same-Client consolidation, Market Maker identity, Fund name/BIC), and the matching/tolerance rules in §4.3(3).
